subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should OpenClaw expose configured `agents.list[].description` values through the model-visible `agents_list` tool output?
rationale: The config field is already accepted, but surfacing it to agents changes the model-visible discovery contract and prompt/routing surface, so maintainer product intent is needed before closing the issue as implemented.

options.title: Accept narrow agents_list exposure
options.body: Refresh and review the linked PR so nonblank configured descriptions are returned by `agents_list` with docs and regression tests.

options.title: Keep descriptions config-only
options.body: Document that `description` is operator metadata for humans/config tooling and close or retitle the linked PR accordingly.

options.title: Defer to broader agent-discovery design
options.body: Leave this issue open behind a larger discovery/prompt-injection design alongside the sibling agent-list prompt issue.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow agents_list exposure
recommendation.body: Refresh and review the linked PR so nonblank configured descriptions are returned by `agents_list` with docs and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced `agents_list` and owns much of the recent multi-agent/config routing history for this surface.
